description: The easiest way to see the whole LDI fleet at once: no template variables to set, no filters to configure, just open it. Built entirely from this repo's shared views/functions (v_ldi_machine_latest_full, v_ldi_alarm_context, f_ldi_yield_pct, v_machine_spc_fleet) -- every number here traces back to one governed source, not a one-off query. For deeper drill-down (per-machine SPC ranking, board traceability, event timelines), use the Manufacturing, Engineering Analytics, or Machine Snapshot dashboards instead.

panels.title: ◉ Fleet Availability

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = true) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 0) AS value
FROM public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full

panels.description: Percent of the registered LDI fleet currently running (public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full, migration 052 -- the shared latest-snapshot view).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = true) AS value FROM public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full

panels.title: ◉ Estimated Yield (1h)

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT-safe rewrite (World-Class QA, 2026-08-06): calling public.f_ldi_yield_pct() here defeated TimescaleDB chunk exclusion once compress_after started compressing older chunks -- EXPLAIN ANALYZE showed ~115ms / 13000+ buffers touched (scanning every chunk) for the function-call form vs ~2ms / 58 buffers for the identical logic inlined directly. Same formula as f_ldi_yield_pct() (migration 046), just inlined so the time bound is visible to the planner at plan time. */
SELECT COALESCE(
      LEAST(
          ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) <= pe_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pe_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1),
          ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4)) <= je_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE je_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1)
      ),
      ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) <= pe_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pe_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1),
      ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4)) <= je_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE je_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1)
  ) AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE "time" BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND NOW()

panels.description: Fleet-wide PE/JE yield over the last hour. Inlined copy of public.f_ldi_yield_pct()'s formula (migration 046) -- calling the function directly defeated chunk exclusion against compressed chunks (World-Class QA, 2026-08-06), so this panel computes it inline instead. Keep in sync with the function if the formula ever changes.

panels.title: ◉ Critical Alarms (1h)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::NUMERIC AS value
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
WHERE a.logdate > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND m.alarm_type = 'A';

panels.description: Alarms in the last hour whose master code (public.ldi_alarm_ms_code.alarm_type) is 'A' (Alarm-class, the more severe of the 2 real values -- the other is 'W' for Warning). World-Class QA pass: the original ILIKE '%Critical%' filter never matched anything since the real column only ever holds single-letter codes, so this KPI silently showed 0 regardless of real critical activity across 3 dashboards -- confirmed live (14 real 'A' alarms in the prior hour, vs. 0 reported).

panels.title: ◈ Machine Status

targets.rawSql:
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine", CASE WHEN state THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'IDLE' END AS "State",
       mo AS "Job (MO)", fpn AS "Part (FPN)", layer_name AS "Layer",
       CASE WHEN log_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT) END AS "Board Progress",
       ROUND(temperature::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Temp (°C)", ROUND(humidity::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Humidity (%RH)",
       ROUND(thickness::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Thickness (mm)",
       CASE WHEN is_stale THEN 'STALE (>5min)' ELSE 'live' END AS "Freshness"
FROM public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full
ORDER BY eqp_id

panels.description: One row per registered machine, always -- straight from public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full (migration 052). No filters to set up.

panels.title: ◈ Recent Alarms (last 50)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT alarm_time AS "Time", eqp_id AS "Machine", errorcode AS "Code", alarm_msg AS "Message",
       ROUND(temperature::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Temp (°C)", ROUND(humidity::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Humidity (%RH)",
       match_type AS "Match"
FROM public.v_ldi_alarm_context
ORDER BY alarm_time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Last 50 alarms fleet-wide, straight from public.v_ldi_alarm_context (migration 053, exact-event-linked). "Match" shows exact (authored by the machine at write-time) vs nearest (inferred).

panels.title: ◈ Process Capability by Machine

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT: reads public.v_machine_spc_fleet, which itself performs the same per-row unpivot+STDDEV Cpk computation on every call (not materialized/cached). Same root cause and same investigated-with-no-improvement history as the other SPC panels. Exempted 2026-08-06 World-Class QA pass; materializing this view is a larger follow-up, not a dashboard-only fix. */
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine", n_pe AS "PE Samples", cpk_pe AS "Cpk (PE)", pe_pass_rate AS "PE Pass %",
       n_je AS "JE Samples", cpk_je AS "Cpk (JE)", je_pass_rate AS "JE Pass %", worst_cpk AS "Worst Cpk"
FROM public.v_machine_spc_fleet
ORDER BY worst_cpk ASC NULLS LAST

panels.description: 24h rolling process capability per machine, from public.v_machine_spc_fleet (migrations 041/042). Sorted worst-first so the machine needing attention is always at the top.
